name: adhoc
description: Stops Claude from racing on ad-hoc work. Methodical-mode pre-response checklist injected every turn (Restate, Verified/Unverified assumptions, Read Floor, Approach Deliberation, Blast Radius, Stall Check, Competing Hypotheses, Goal-Driven Execution). Stop hook enforces four gates: file:line citation verifier, uncertainty-tell scanner, zero-tool-call grounding audit, and pre-Stop critic-agent. /adhoc:casual (one turn skip), /adhoc:trust-me (one-turn strict bypass), /adhoc:off (session disable). /adhoc:deep for heavier analysis, /adhoc:second-opinion for independent critique.
